overview.about: The CME Group Tour Championship is the season-ending finale of the LPGA, contested by the year's top players at Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida. It offers one of the largest first prizes in women's golf, a multi-million-dollar cheque that can transform a career.
overview.nextEvent: The next CME Group Tour Championship is played at Tiburon in Naples. Only the leading players qualify, and the winner takes home one of the biggest paydays in the women's game.
